lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters are arranged in roughly vertical columns posterior to the fifth gill slit. These blobs are significantly larger and more widely spaced than those on the cephalic region, forming a semi-regular grid pattern across the mid-lateral surface.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of slightly elevated luminance intersect with horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating distinct anchor nodes within a grid-like structure along the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper flank, characterized by high-luminance upper edges and sharp vertical gradients to lower-luminance shadows immediately below, running parallel to the dorsal midline.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A low-density distribution of small, scattered high-luminance blobs is visible across the lower and middle sections of the first dorsal fin's macro-mask.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small irregular indentation or 'nick' is visible on the distal posterior margin of the left pectoral fin. A dark, vertical marking or possible lesion is present immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal organisms (Echeneidae) attached to the body: one specimen on the mid-lateral flank and at least three specimens situated ventrally near the pectoral fin insertion.
